protocol.data: Spring-Gaus mpm_synthetic (official Google Drive zip downloaded by v3f; 3 scenes extracted to data/external_datasets/v3g_springgaus_extract)
protocol.views: all 10 cameras used for training (official protocol); eval_cam 5 is one of the training cameras (render-only)
protocol.frames: first 20 of 30 frames (N_FRAME 20, dt 0.03 s) observed; frames 20-29 (0.60-0.87 s) are future prediction
protocol.stages: static 3DGS 30000 it -> velocity 100 it (+3000 Gaussian refine) -> dynamic spring-mass 300 it (+3000 refine first; n_step 100->150->200 at it 100/200) -> eval
protocol.metrics: Chamfer distance (mean of the two directed mean NN L2 distances, 8192-pt subsample, scene units; also squared x1e3) between Spring-Gaus anchor-interpolated Gaussian centres and GT MPM particles. Fit = frames 0-19 at training dt; future = frames 20-29 from its 60 Hz prediction rollout linearly interpolated in time; static baseline = GT frame 0 vs GT frame k. PSNR on eval cam 5 fit renders vs GT images. Metric code is ours (scripts/v3g/sg_eval.py): the official repo writes point clouds but ships no CD/EMD script, so numbers are not directly comparable to the paper table.
protocol.params: Spring-Gaus does not output E or nu: it learns per-anchor spring stiffness log10 k (2048 anchors, unit mass per anchor, init 3.0), friction, rebound, soft-k. Only the ranking of median log10 k vs GT E can be compared.
protocol.patches: build-compat only: #include <cfloat> added to submodules/simple-knn/simple_knn.cu (CUDA 12.6); env torch 2.4.1+cu121, pytorch3d 0.7.8, open3d 0.17.0, pillow 9.5.0 (pillow>=10 breaks its np.byte image loader); no algorithmic change
protocol.hardware: 1x NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB (GPU 7), shared with other jobs at ~100% util, so wall-clock is an upper bound
protocol.restart_note: torus was first started on GPU 0 at 01:30Z and aborted in the dynamic stage (GPU reassignment); restarted from scratch on GPU 7; the GPU-7 run is the one reported

our_model_v3f.source: docs/v3f/SPRINGGAUS_SYN.json ensemble9 (V2 main B/C/D x 3 seeds), canonical 3-view triplet t0, 30 frames; offset/ridge = leave-one-scene-out over 14 scenes; support_mean_baseline ignores the video; cost = one forward pass per run, no per-scene optimisation

duck.wall_clock_note: static+velocity(+its refine) ran in an earlier attempt that later hit CUDA OOM in the dynamic stage (GPU co-located with other jobs); their checkpoints were reused, so total = successful attempt + those stage times. Failed attempts' wasted compute is excluded; see logs/sg_time_<scene>_*.txt

ranking_check.note: GT E order torus(1e6) > duck(3e5) > apple(1e5). Spring-Gaus median log10 spring k 3.50 > 3.28 > 2.80: same order (3/3 pairs) although k is not convertible to Pa. Our K0 ensemble E/rho: duck 1.02e5 > torus 9.2e4 > apple 8.2e4 (2/3 pairs; torus-vs-duck wrong), all ~5-10x low; on the full 14-scene set (docs/v3f) our K0 E Spearman is -0.21, i.e. no ranking signal there.
